name: Brimley
bio: Archetype: Extra Action, Cleanser. ⌽ Skill 2 applies [Let's Ride] on one ally, which boosts ATK and cleanses debuffs. ⌽ Gains 1 Moxie after 3 Extra Actions by the buffed ally (once per turn). ⌽ Gains 1 stack of [Equestrianism] when using Skill 1 or when any ally takes Extra Action (once per turn). At 3 stacks, using S1 causes the buffed ally to cast their S2. ⌽ Ult causes the buffed ally to cast their S1.
